source_name: e-beszámoló — Electronic Financial Reports Portal (Elektronikus Beszámoló Portál)
organization: Igazságügyi Minisztérium — Céginformációs és az Elektronikus Cégeljárásban Közreműködő Szolgálat (Ministry of Justice, Company Information Service)
license: Public (free to view); reuse/redistribution terms unclear
notes: Authoritative financial-statements portal (Ministry of Justice). All annual financial statements (beszámoló) are FREE to view with no registration, by company name / cégjegyzékszám / adószám. Reports include structured key figures (sales revenue, profit after tax, assets, equity, liabilities) + PDF + electronic form (XML). BUT the search endpoint (/Search/Results) is reCAPTCHA-protected (verified: response {"errorText":"A reCaptcha kitöltése nem megfelelő."}; recaptcha.js in page) -> automated/bulk access blocked, do NOT bypass. The financial spine; manual access free. Keyed on cégjegyzékszám / adószám.

source_name: e-cégjegyzék / Cégszolgálat — free company information (Ingyenes Céginformáció)
license: Free basic info; certified/full data paid
notes: Official Company Register free-information portal ('Cégszolgálat Ingyenes Céginformáció'). Verified reachable (HTTP 200). Provides FREE basic company info (name, cégjegyzékszám, seat, status, main activity) by search. FULL/certified company extracts (cégkivonat) and detailed data (officers, owners, history) are PAID via the Céginformációs Szolgálat or commercial resellers. The register-side identity source.

organization: Nemzeti Adó- és Vámhivatal (NAV / National Tax and Customs Administration)
notes: NAV publishes taxpayer/VAT-subject databases (áfaalanyok), updated DAILY. Verified pages reachable (HTTP 200). Online single + group/batch query (upload a file of adószám -> get VAT status). Some lists downloadable (CSV, e.g. excise subjects). Validates/enriches adószám <-> name <-> VAT status; flags cancelled tax numbers. Tax-side complement to the register. Multi-database query also available.

source_name: VIES — EU VAT validation (HU VAT) / NAV közösségi adószám
notes: VIES validates a Hungarian EU VAT number (közösségi adószám = HU + the 8-digit tax base number / törzsszám). Validation/enrichment only; does not enumerate companies.

source_name: KSH — Hungarian Central Statistical Office business register
organization: Központi Statisztikai Hivatal (KSH / Hungarian Central Statistical Office)
notes: KSH maintains the statistical business register and the statisztikai számjel (17-digit statistical code, which embeds the 8-digit tax base + TEÁOR + legal form + county). Publishes aggregate enterprise statistics and the TEÁOR activity classification; not a per-company open master, but the authority for the statistical code and activity codes.

Electronic public procurement system + Közbeszerzési Értesítő (procurement bulletin). Publishes tenders/awards with supplier adószám + name. Secondary company cross-reference for entities bidding for public contracts. Not a company master.

source_name: Commercial aggregators (OPTEN, Bisnode/Dun & Bradstreet, Céginfo, companyapi.hu, ...)
notes: Vendors (OPTEN, Bisnode, Céginfo, companyapi.hu) resell the full cégjegyzék (officers, owners, history) + parsed financials + credit data. companyapi.hu advertises ~31 fields direct from the Ministry of Justice Company Information Service, no contract. The realistic path to FULL register data (paid) + STRUCTURED financials at scale (since e-beszámoló is reCAPTCHA-gated and full register data is paid). Proprietary, paid.
